name: smooth-bar-root
why: The case that proves the section reads the face's own curvature: a dia. 12 bar buried to its axis along a 40 x 40 x 8 plate, its two straight root generators smoothed. On the plate the blend leaves with zero curvature; on the bar the section direction runs round the cylinder, so it must leave with 1/6 per mm, and curvature_jump_per_mm measures whether it did: a section that assumed planes would read 0.167 here. The bar's ends cut the blends, which is a crease by design and not a rail.
